canonical_statement: For a twice continuously differentiable time-dependent Lagrangian on a finite-dimensional real Euclidean configuration space and a twice continuously differentiable path with fixed endpoints on a nondegenerate compact interval, stationarity of the action under every continuously differentiable endpoint-vanishing variation implies the pointwise Euler-Lagrange equation on the interval interior.
